acertar: to hit the mark; to get it right
advertirle: to warn you; to point out to you
agradecen: they thank; they are grateful for
agradezco: I thank; I am grateful for
apetece: appeals, is desired; (here) is wished for
asegurarse: to make sure; to secure oneself
cargo: "a cargo de" in the charge of
consecuente: "más consecuente" most far-reaching in its consequences
contrario: contrary; "por el contrario" on the contrary
coronarse: to be crowned; to crown oneself
cuanto: how much; "en cuanto" as soon as; "cuanto" all that
cuenta: account; por su cuenta: at their own risk
damas: ladies; las Damas (a pass of the Andes)
dejar: to leave; to let; "dejar de" to fail to
desatarse: to break loose, to be unleashed
echarlo: to throw him out; to expel him
encargarle: to entrust to you; to ask you
entender: to understand; (dar a entender) to intimate
fandango: fandango (dance); (here, figuratively) a row, a fight
favor: favour; "en favor de" in favour of
fiencée: (Rue de la) Fiencée: a street name as printed
fines: ends; (a fines de) at the end of
god: God (in an English address, as printed)
hacerle: to make him; to do to him
hacerles: to do them; to make them
le: to him, to her, to it
manifestarle: to tell you, to show you
mediados: (a mediados de) in the middle of
mirarlo: to look at it; to regard it
mínimo: least, smallest; lo más mínimo: the least bit
mío: my; Muy señor mío: Dear Sir
parar: to stay, to lodge; to stop
pico: peak; y pico: and a bit (over)
placer: pleasure; will (a placer de: at the will of)
planchón: el Planchón (a pass of the Andes)
ponerle: to put on it; to give it
prevenirle: to warn you, to advise you
q: (Q. B. S. M.) who kisses your hand
quererme: to love me; to want me
repasar: to recross; to go over again
representar: to represent; to play a part
respecta: concerns; por lo que respecta a: as regards
sazón: a la sazón: at that time
sea: be (subj.); "que sea" however ... it may be
seducir: to seduce; (here) to suborn, to win over
sentir: "soy de sentir" I am of the opinion
sirviéndose: being so kind as to; making use of
susse: Susse (name of a ship, as printed)
sí: yes; itself ("sobre sí", "por sí mismos" by themselves)
testamentaría: estate (of a deceased); execution of a will
vela: sail; «dar la vela»: to set sail
verter: to pour out; (here) to let fall, to utter
vista: sight; "a primera vista" at first sight
vuelvo: I return; «vuelvo a ser»: I become again
aix-lachapelle: Aix-la-Chapelle (Aachen), as the layer gives it
